IN THE  COURT OF THE SESSIONS JUDGE,ARARIA.
A.B.P. NO. 1961 of 2020 
Arising out of Forbesganj(Simraha) P.S  case no. 956/2020     
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------                
Subham Kr. Gupta and 5 others 
            Petitioner.
Versus
  State of Bihar 
 Opposite Party
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------     
Appearance          For the petitioners: Mr. D.N.Sen,Advocate.
For the prosecution:
Mr. L.N.Yadav, P.P.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This anticipatory bail petition filed on behalf of accused petitioners namely 1.
Shubham Kumar Gupta 2. Shankar Gupta 3. Geeta Devi 4. Lal Mohan @ Sugam Gupta 5.
Lakhan Gupta and 6. Ram Gupta   who apprehend their arrest in connection with
Forbesganj(Simraha) P.S. case no. 956/2020 u/s  341, 323, 307,498A /34  I.P.c. & u/s 3/4 of D.P.
Act pressed today by learned counsel.  
Out of the aforesaid six petitioners, two of them namely Shubham Kumar Gupta
and 2. Shankar Pd. Gupta have been arrested by the police during pendency of the instant A.B.P.
so their bail petition has been dismissed as withdrawn being infructuous and their names have
been deleted from the instant A.B.P
. 
Heard both the sides in physical mode of court proceeding. 
The learned counsel for the accused petitioners submits that the accused
petitioners are  innocent and they have been falsely implicated in this case due to family dispute.
They  never made any demand nor did they torture or harass the informant  in any way. The
allegations made by the informant  is totally false and fabricated. The learned counsel further
submits that the petitioners are inlaws and relatives of the husband of the informant against
whom there is no such specific allegation of overt act. Moreover the dispute if any has amicably
been settled between the parties, a compromise petition to this effect has also been filed with the
bail petition and informant is present in the court to support the factum of compromise, in such
circumstances, the petitioners deserve to be released on anticipatory bail., 
The learned P.P. opposed the anticipatory bail but conceded on the point of
compromise. 
Heard the submission of both the sides and perused the L.C.R.  Apparently  the
informant wife Ruchi Kumari  has  lodged this case against her petitioner-husband Subham
Gupta(now withdrawn due to arrest by the police)  and other members and relatives of inlaws
family alleging against them all for committing cruelty and harassment for non-fulfilment of
dowry demand. 
Due to amicable settlement of matrimonial dispute between husband and wife as
well as with the other members and relative of inlaws family, a joint compromise petition duly
signed by the parties and their respective counsel to this effect has been  filed with bail petition. 
As amicable relationship has been restored between the parties, I find it is a fit
case to  grant anticipatory bail. Accordingly, anticipatory bail prayer of the petitioner no. 3 to 6
is allowed. In the event of their arrest or surrender before the court below within a period of
four  weeks  from  receipt of this order,  the petitioners namely Geeta Devi, Lal Mohan @
Sugam Gupta, Lakhan Gupta and Ram Gupta shall be released on bail on furnishing their bail
bonds of Rs. 5,000/- with two sureties of like amount each to the  satisfaction of the court below
subject to the conditions as laid down u/s 438(2) Cr.P.C. 
(Dictated)
     sd/-
(P.K.Dixit)
                                  Sessions Judge
13.01.2021
